text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш is feeling lost without a clear
sense of
direction. To get back on track,
she speaks to
Токай Тейо, a runner who
has had her own fair
share of setbacks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Токай Тэйо explains with a smile that she
found
her way forward again by asking
herself what the
person she admires
would do in her shoes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш thinks of her parents, and
after some
consideration, she feels more
optimistic about
the change in her
schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She decides on a new trajectory and
seeks to take
on a challenge even bigger
than the Kikuka
Sho—the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
